''Tas-Sitt Xhur'' | short name = VHS | founded = {{Start date and age|df=y|1948}} | owner = Dr. Anton Tabone | stadium = [[2025–26_Maltese_National_Amateur_League#Venues|Various]] | owntitle = President | manager = [[Oliver Spiteri]]{{cite news |url=https://tvmnews.mt/sport/oliver-spiteri-se-jkun-il-kowc-ta-victoria-hotspurs-fl-amateur-league/ |title=Oliver Spiteri se jkun il-kowċ ta’ Victoria Hotspurs fl-Amateur League |publisher = TV< Sport |first=Sandro |last=Micallef |date=15 June 2024 }} | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = [[Maltese Challenge League]] | season = [[2025–26 Maltese National Amateur League|2025-26]] | position = [[Maltese National Amateur League I]] ''(2nd)'' | website = https://www.victoriahotspursfc.com/ | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _whiteshoulders | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = _mlt22h | leftarm1 = white | body1 = FF0000 | rightarm1 = white | shorts1 = FF0000 | socks1 = FF0000 | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _redshoulders | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = _mlt22a | leftarm2 = FF0000 | body2 = white | rightarm2 = FF0000 | shorts2 = white | socks2 = white }} '''Victoria Hotspurs Football Club''' is a Maltese semi-professional [[association football|football]] club from the town of [[Victoria, Malta|Victoria]], [[Gozo]]. From the 2024–25 season it has switched from the [[Gozo Football League|Gozo football league system]] to the [[Maltese football league system|Maltese]].{{cite news |date= 30 April 2024|title= Victoria Hotspurs approved as new members of the MFA|url= https://sport.timesofmalta.com/2024/04/30/victoria-hotspurs-approved-as-new-members-of-the-mfa/|work= [[Times of Malta]]|access-date= 30 April 2024}} The club was founded in 1948 and, prior to their migration, has won 13 [[Gozo Football League First Division|Gozo First Division]] titles, the last one in the [[2018–19 Gozo First Division|2018–19 season]]. The club is popularly known simply as ''il-Hotspurs''. In 2000, when they won their tenth title, they became the first Gozitan club to be awarded a ''[[star (football badge)|Golden Star for Sport Excellence]]''. Moreover, Victoria Hotspurs also became the first - and so far the only - club competing in the [[Gozo Football League]] who had a Gozitan player from their ranks debuting and representing [[Malta national football team|Malta]] in international football matches.{{cite web|url= https://eu-football.info/_clubs.php?id=136&page=2|title= Malta team player clubs |website= EU-Football.info|access-date= 18 June 2023}} The club also holds the record for the most consecutive wins across all domestic competitions in Malta, a run stretching to 32 matches.{{cite web|url= https://www.victoriahotspursfc.com/2024/10/victoria-hotspurs-%f0%9d%90%91%f0%9d%90%9e%f0%9d%90%9a%f0%9d%90%9c%f0%9d%90%a1ed-%f0%9d%90%87%f0%9d%90%a2%f0%9d%90%ac%f0%9d%90%ad%f0%9d%90%a8%f0%9d%90%ab%f0%9d%90%a2%f0%9d%90%9c-%f0%9d%90%8c|title= Victoria Hotspurs Reached Historic Milestone of 20 Consecutive Domestic Wins |website= Victoria Hotspurs FC|access-date= 8 February 2025}}"}}
